name: fast-recipe
label: Fast recipe ASMR (Nick DiGiovanni / Khairul Aming)
description: Hero shot + premise in 1 s, beat-cut ASMR step montage, plating, the bite in silence, verdict.

sync.broll: food macro IS the picture (~80%); talking head only at hook and taste
sync.fillers: snap zooms, sound-only crunch/sizzle beats, quick reaction cutaways every 2-4 s
sync.music: upbeat from frame 1, cut on every beat, drops out for the bite (silence + crunch), back for the verdict
sync.emotion_map: shock/curiosity → momentum → anticipation → payoff (bite in silence)

evidence: est. from public sources; calibrate with measured references
compliance_lock: no body shaming or before/after transformations
supplement claims only in label-approved wording
